notes: Evaluates /cadence-retro cross-ticket synthesis: empty-archive clean no-op, rework/effort/deferred-followup aggregation preserving unresolved tiers and existing II-NNN/PROD-NNN dedupe, and confirmation-gated atomic promotion.

evals.name: empty-archive-clean-noop-read-only
evals.prompt: Run /cadence-retro in an adopted repository whose archive/ directory is empty.
evals.expected_output: Runs retro_scan.py, observes status=empty_archive and archived_tickets=0, exits 0 reporting nothing to synthesize without creating files or reserving IDs.
assertions: Runs retro_scan.py cleanly against an empty archive/
Reports status=empty_archive and exits 0 without creating or modifying files

evals.name: synthesizes-metrics-rework-and-deferred-followups
evals.prompt: Run retro_scan.py across archived tickets with >=2 review cycles, over-estimate effort, Deferred follow-ups, an unguarded citation sweep, an existing II-001 entry, and a ticket with empty tier.
evals.expected_output: Aggregates exact rework hotspots, stage_effort sums from metadata.yaml (never git timestamps), Deferred follow-ups, DEAD-CITATION-SWEEP warnings, existing II/PROD counts, and counts missing/empty tier as unresolved rather than Low.
assertions: Flags review rework hotspots (>=2 cycles), over-estimate tickets, Deferred follow-ups, and SKIPPED citation sweeps
Preserves empty tier under unresolved rather than defaulting to Low
Reads recorded stage_effort/actual_effort cleanly and deduplicates existing insights

check.setup_sh:
mkdir -p "$FIX/archive/ACME-10" "$FIX/archive/ACME-11" "$FIX/archive/ACME-12" "$FIX/docs/agentic-sdlc"
printf 'id: ACME-10
tier: High
status: archived
archived_at: 2026-10-01T10:00:00Z
estimated_effort: 1h
actual_effort: 2h
stage_effort:
  - stage: implementation
    effort: 1h 30m
  - stage: code-review
    effort: 30m
' > "$FIX/archive/ACME-10/metadata.yaml"
printf '# Sub
## Discussion
<!-- cadence-run:cycle n=1 phase=code-review blocking=2 nonblocking=1 -->
<!-- cadence-run:cycle n=2 phase=code-review blocking=0 nonblocking=0 -->
## Resolution
Follow-ups created: Deferred -- see discussion
' > "$FIX/archive/ACME-10/submission.md"
printf '# Summary
DEAD-CITATION-SWEEP: SKIPPED
' > "$FIX/archive/ACME-10/summary.md"
printf 'id: ACME-11
tier: ""
status: archived
archived_at: 2026-10-02T10:00:00Z
' > "$FIX/archive/ACME-11/metadata.yaml"
printf 'id: ACME-12
tier: Low
status: archived
archived_at: 2026-10-03T10:00:00Z
' > "$FIX/archive/ACME-12/metadata.yaml"
printf '# Summary
None -- no inbound citations.
' > "$FIX/archive/ACME-12/summary.md"
printf '### II-001: Existing
| Source Ticket | `ACME-12` |
' > "$FIX/docs/agentic-sdlc/intent-insights.md"

evals.name: full-scan-and-confirmation-gated-promotion
evals.prompt: Run full retro_scan.py across all archived tickets and verify promotion rules use mint-id.sh --reserve II|PROD without editing immutable archive specs.
evals.expected_output: Full scan reports ACME-10 rework, over-estimate, Deferred follow-ups, unguarded citation sweep, missing summary for ACME-11; promotion rules require explicit confirmation, mint-id.sh --reserve II|PROD, authored-doc-gate.sh, and immutability under archive/<id>/.
assertions: Full scan catches ACME-10 rework_hotspots, deferred_followups, unguarded_citation_sweeps, over_estimate_tickets, and missing_summary
Requires explicit operator confirmation before reserving II/PROD IDs via mint-id.sh or editing insight registers
Forbids mutating immutable archived files under archive/<id>/

script.setup_sh:
mkdir -p "$FIX/archive/ACME-10" "$FIX/archive/ACME-11" "$FIX/docs/agentic-sdlc"
printf 'id: ACME-10
tier: High
status: archived
archived_at: 2026-10-01T10:00:00Z
estimated_effort: 1h
actual_effort: 2h
stage_effort:
  - stage: implementation
    effort: 2h
' > "$FIX/archive/ACME-10/metadata.yaml"
printf '<!-- cadence-run:cycle n=1 blocking=1 -->
<!-- cadence-run:cycle n=2 blocking=0 -->
Follow-ups created: Deferred
' > "$FIX/archive/ACME-10/submission.md"
printf 'DEAD-CITATION-SWEEP: SKIPPED
' > "$FIX/archive/ACME-10/summary.md"
printf 'id: ACME-11
tier: Low
status: archived
' > "$FIX/archive/ACME-11/metadata.yaml"
printf '### II-001: Existing
' > "$FIX/docs/agentic-sdlc/intent-insights.md"
